rows: Current-season batting statistics, one row per MLB player

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Current-season batting lines for every MLB player. Use for home runs, hits, RBI, steals, walks, strikeouts, AVG, OBP, SLG and OPS. Use batting_stats() for another season, one league, or qualified leaders only.

Current-season fielding statistics at player-position grain

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Current regular-season fielding lines at player-position grain. Use for defensive innings, putouts, assists, errors, chances, double plays, fielding percentage and range factors. A player can appear in multiple rows for multiple positions.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Current regular-season fielding statistics, one row per player-position combination. Use `outs` for exact defensive-inning arithmetic.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Current shortstops with substantial defensive playing time.", "sql": "SELECT player_name, last_team_abbreviation, outs, errors, fielding_percentage FROM mlb.main.current_fielding WHERE position_abbreviation = 'SS' AND outs >= 600 ORDER BY fielding_percentage DESC"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current MLB Fielding Statistics

Current-season pitching statistics, one row per MLB player

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Current-season pitching lines for every MLB player. Use for starts, wins, saves, innings, strikeouts, ERA, WHIP and per-nine rates. Use pitching_stats() for another season, one league, or qualified leaders only.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Complete current-season MLB pitching statistics, one row per player.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Current ERA leaders among pitchers with at least 300 outs.", "sql": "SELECT player_name, last_team_abbreviation, innings_pitched, strikeouts, era FROM mlb.main.current_pitching WHERE outs >= 300 ORDER BY era LIMIT 20"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current MLB Pitching Statistics

Current AL and NL regular-season standings, one row per team

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Current AL and NL regular-season standings, one row per team. Start here for today's division races, records, games back, run differential, streaks, and clinching state. For another season or the wild-card view, call standings().
rows.vgi.doc_md: The current MLB regular-season standings as an ordinary read-only table. Results follow MLB's public Stats API cache policy. Use `standings()` for historical seasons and alternate standings views.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Current division tables in official rank order.", "sql": "SELECT division_name, division_rank, team_name, wins, losses, games_back FROM mlb.main.current_standings ORDER BY division_name, division_rank"}, {"description": "Teams with the best run differential.", "sql": "SELECT team_name, wins, losses, run_differential FROM mlb.main.current_standings ORDER BY run_differential DESC"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current MLB Standings
